_readme: Partner offers on MyPayCalc. An offer only shows once it has a url (paste the tracking link from the partner once approved). Each page shows at most one: the highest priority offer for that page that is in season (months 1-12, empty = all year). Disclosed next to the link and on /affiliate-disclosure.

offers.heading: Getting your tax return done?
offers.text: Lodge online with a registered tax agent and see your refund estimate before you submit.

offers.heading: Know your take-home? Give the savings part a better rate
offers.text: Compare high-interest savings accounts from Australian banks, then set an automatic transfer for payday.

offers.heading: Check what your super fund is charging
offers.text: Your employer pays 12% on top. Compare fees and returns so more of it stays yours.

offers.heading: Paying more than you need to?
offers.text: Compare current home loan rates and see what a lower one would take off your repayments.
